review_scope: Frozen borrowed-cell contract, retained v1 and one root-authorized v2 internal-iteration variant; source, actual execution, complete raw comparisons and normal delivery path.

findings.description: Initial v2 README quoted v1 timings without a v1 label. Final README explicitly separates v1 and v2 and denies acceleration admission.

limitations: Same existing fixtures repeated; not new physical-history counts.
Numeric exact equality does not assert signed-zero bit equality.
Clone counters exclude initial cache clone, coordinate decode and other allocations.
CPU0 profile-off paired observations do not establish general speedup; single profiles cannot override them.
Unchanged batch executable still selects cell-cache.
next_action: Publish scoped source, evidence, DAG and dual backups/handoff. No additional optional native rerun or optimization variant required.
